description: Ω7 discovery engine — perception: walks a captured page (fixtures only in-sandbox; live capture legs are owner-machine CDP scripts, see docs/DISCOVERY.md), classifies DOM nodes into an ApplicationGraph, and appends both the capture bytes and the graph to the user's vault as evidence objects (P5 provenance: every claim node cites capture bytes). ZERO LLM, ZERO network — deterministic by construction.

engine.doc: perceive {fixture: {name, pageRef? {ns, id}}} → {graphId: {ns, id, rev, cid}, nodeCount, edgeCount}. READ-class engine op — the pinned grammar allows risk only on contract-kind contributions, so engines declare none; this op reads a fixture and appends evidence, and its internal vault.append@1 calls are gated by the vault contract's MUTATION risk (journaled by law). pageRef defaults to {ns: 'discovery', id: 'capture:<name>'}. The page capture bytes AND the graph are appended to the vault; every GraphNode cites the capture revision via discovery.evidence-ref@1.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: graph identity: 'graph:<fixtureName>' (matches the vault object id in ns 'discovery')

fields.name: capturedAt
fields.doc: epoch ms from the CAPTURE fixture (never wall clock — determinism)

fields.name: source
fields.doc: capture provenance: which fixture produced this graph

fields.name: nodes
fields.doc: discovery.graph-node@1[] — classified interactive/structural nodes

fields.name: edges
fields.doc: discovery.causal-edge@1[] — EMPTY from perception; causal edges come from discovery.observe@1

schema.doc: discovery.application-graph@1 — the shared ApplicationGraph evidence model for Ω8/Ω9 (the contract of record; the TS types in both discovery plugins are mirrors of this declaration).

fields.name: id
fields.doc: deterministic path id: 'n' + child-index path from the root ('n0', 'n0.3.2')

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: control | field | button | list | container | menu | menu-item (menu kinds added D-311 for VariationChannel MENU_PATH)

fields.name: label
fields.doc: aria-label → own text → placeholder → first descendant text → id → tag(:role) fallback, whitespace-collapsed, capped at 60 chars

fields.name: selectorHint
fields.doc: '#id' when the DOM node has an id; else a CSS path of tag:nth-of-type(k) segments from the capture root

fields.name: evidence
fields.doc: discovery.evidence-ref@1[] — every claim node cites capture bytes (≥1 ref, constitutional)

schema.doc: discovery.graph-node@1 — one classified node of an ApplicationGraph.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: deterministic derivation id: 'e<index>' in observation order

fields.name: from
fields.doc: node id of the causal origin (user action / network-attributed node)

fields.name: to
fields.doc: node id of the node the DOM update landed on

fields.name: trigger
fields.doc: click | type | network — what caused the DOM update

fields.name: latencyMs
fields.doc: ts(dom-update) − ts(cause), authored fixture timestamps (deterministic)

fields.name: evidence
fields.doc: discovery.evidence-ref@1[] — cites the trace lines backing the edge (cause line + network lines + dom-update line), by byte span

schema.doc: discovery.causal-edge@1 — a cause→effect edge between graph nodes, produced by discovery.observe@1.

fields.name: ns
fields.doc: G0 minimum (D-357): the vault namespace holding the capture bytes — the triple {ns, id, rev} downstream consumers (inference normalizeEvidence) require

fields.name: id
fields.doc: G0 minimum: the vault object id

fields.name: rev
fields.doc: G0 minimum: the vault object revision (>= 1)

fields.name: casRef
fields.doc: DERIVED from the triple: '<ns>/<id>@<rev>' (e.g. 'discovery/capture:webmail-inbox@1'); kept for byte-span citation readers

fields.name: span
fields.doc: optional {start, end}: UTF-8 BYTE offsets [start, end) into the referenced capture bytes — observation cites per event line; perception cites whole-capture (no span)

schema.doc: discovery.evidence-ref@1 — the provenance unit: which vault object's bytes back a claim. v1 (D-357): the ref carries the {ns, id, rev} triple plus the derived casRef — the falsifier proved casRef-only refs were silently dropped by inference's fail-closed evidence filter, zeroing the perceive→infer seam.

capabilities.justification: Evidence is constitutional (P5): the page capture bytes and the ApplicationGraph persist in the USER'S VAULT, not in this plugin — port:vault.append@1 writes the capture + graph objects (ns 'discovery'), port:vault.get@1 reads the capture bytes back after the append (integrity self-check). The composition grants exactly these two per user-signed Recipe — never this manifest.
